archive_ui.plan_not_applied: Plan: {{state}} · Archive data has not been modified by this plan.
archive_ui.policy_unavailable: Saved source policy: unavailable; scope needs review.
archive_ui.history_scope_pending: Sources for history backfill: discovery is pending.
archive_ui.history_scope_complete: History discovery is complete; see the result for covered sources.
archive_ui.history_scope_unknown: Sources for history backfill: exact coverage is unavailable.
archive_ui.timestamps_only: This plan only repairs stored message timestamps.
archive_ui.effect_reset-progress: Progress reset clears the saved cursor for later history reconciliation.
archive_ui.effect_remove-duplicate-progress: Duplicate progress removal keeps the primary record for each source.
archive_ui.effect_merge-duplicate-messages: Message merge may update retained records and remove duplicate backup records.
archive_ui.effect_exclude-by-policy: Policy exclusion removes affected backup data; revision and reaction records may be affected.
archive_ui.effect_quarantine-data: Quarantine preserves evidence and may remove records from their original collection.
archive_ui.effect_unknown: Impact is unknown; review these changes before confirming.
archive_ui.progress_only: This repair plan has no operation deleting backed-up messages.
archive_ui.plan_issues: Plan checks: {{unresolved}} unresolved records; {{issues}} reported issues. Backup integrity has not been verified.
archive_ui.historical_issues: Historical plan checks: {{unresolved}} unresolved records; {{issues}} issues. See the current verification result.
archive_ui.more_sources: {{count}} additional sources; open the full source list.
archive_ui.filtered_total: {{operations}} matching operations in the full plan.
archive_ui.statistics_unavailable: Cannot retrieve the full-scope statistics. Reopen the panel to retry.
archive_ui.effect_progress_insert: Adds a backup progress record; does not delete backed-up messages.
archive_ui.effect_progress_update: Changes backup progress data; does not delete backed-up messages.
archive_ui.effect_progress_delete: Removes a backup progress record; does not delete backed-up messages.
archive_ui.effect_quarantine_move: Removes the message record from its original collection after preserving quarantine evidence.
archive_ui.effect_quarantine_evidence: Adds quarantine evidence; this operation does not remove the original record.
archive_ui.diff_unavailable: The earlier value is unavailable in this saved plan.
archive_ui.survivor_unknown: The retained record relationship could not be verified.
archive_ui.dependency_unknown: A dependency could not be identified. See technical details.
archive_ui.download_scope: Safe JSON covers these {{count}} operations only. Choose download to receive a private file.
archive_ui.download_ready: Safe metadata for {{count}} operations. Recovery images and message content are excluded.
archive_ui.record_types_unavailable: Exact affected data types are unavailable; deletion and quarantine impacts need review.
archive_ui.download_permission: The bot needs Attach Files permission in this channel to download safe JSON. Update the permission, then reopen the panel.
archive_ui.dependencies_unavailable: Some dependency relationships could not be retrieved; this list is incomplete.
archive_ui.quarantine_invalid-channel-cursor: The source progress record has an invalid source identity.
archive_ui.quarantine_unknown: The exact diagnosis is unavailable; see technical details.
archive_ui.rollback_original: Original repair plan: {{count}} operations. Counts below are historical candidates.
archive_ui.rollback_eligible_unknown: Currently recoverable counts and newer-change conflicts are not yet known. Records changed since this run may be retained as conflicts.
archive_ui.effect_progress_combined: Progress resets clear cursors; duplicate removal retains primary records.
archive_ui.quarantine_invalid-identity-or-timestamp: The message identity or timestamp is invalid.
archive_ui.quarantine_large-duplicate-group: The duplicate group is too large to merge safely.
archive_ui.quarantine_conflicting-channel-id: Duplicate records disagree on the source identity.
archive_ui.quarantine_conflicting-user-id: Duplicate records disagree on the author identity.
archive_ui.quarantine_conflicting-timestamp: Duplicate records disagree on the message time.
archive_ui.policy_bot-not-allowlisted: The source bot is absent from the saved allowlist.
archive_ui.policy_webhook-not-allowlisted: The source webhook is absent from the saved allowlist.
archive_ui.policy_rule-exclude: A saved source rule excludes this data.
archive_ui.policy_guild-out-of-scope: The guild is outside the saved archive policy scope.
archive_ui.policy_unknown: The exact failed policy condition is unavailable.
archive_ui.quarantine_conflicting-message-data: Duplicate records disagree on message data.
archive_ui.effect_progress_reset: Clears the saved resume position for history reconciliation; this operation only changes progress data and does not delete backed-up messages.
archive_ui.plan_not_verified: Backup integrity will be checked after execution.
